items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: We had Jack Washington; we had Lester Young, Herschel Evans, and we had Caughey Roberts.

ctx.x: Wait just a moment. I did say we had Joe Keyes, Taddy, Dan Minor. That was the brass, four brass. We had Jack Washington; we had Lester Young, Herschel Evans, and we had Caughey Roberts. Caughey Roberts was from Los Angeles.
